{{Quote|I've often wondered if your clientele all subscribe to the same service—the one listing the most disgusting and disreputable places in the galaxy to meet.|[[I-5YQ]] to [[Lorn Pavan]], upon entering the establishment|<ref name="Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter">''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''</ref>}}
A '''[[Holobooth/Legends|holobooth]] provider''' existed in the [[Zi-Kree Sector]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Underlevels]]. Its proprietor was a balding [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]].

==Description==
The entrance to the establishment was located on a poorly-lit dead-end street in the [[Zi-Kree Sector]]. Just inside was a lobby with an old [[Plasteel/Legends|plasteel]] ticket booth where clients could pay to use one of the establishment's at least nine [[Holobooth/Legends|holobooths]]. The cost for the use of one of these booths was one [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] per half [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] of use. While [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were allowed in the booths, a release form was required to be signed first.

The booths themselves contained a contour [[Couch/Legends|couch]] facing a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]]. They were large enough to hold as many as four beings, but barely. Each booth had a door separating it from the lobby that could be opened with the wave of a hand over a sensor plate.

==History==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Lorn Pavan]], [[I-5YQ]], and [[Zippa]], as well as Zippa's [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]], [[Bilk]], met in [[booth nine]] in order to negotiate the purchase of a [[Holocron/Legends|Jedi Holocron]] from Zippa. After selling the Holocron to Pavan, however, Zippa betrayed Pavan and I-5YQ and took the Holocron, as well as Pavan's credit bills. He left the building after giving Bilk instructions to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Pavan and I-5YQ. The droid, however, used Bilk's own [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] to kill Bilk, and the pair escaped from the building.
